# YuYing (@4yuying)

> High School Senior from Taiwan · School Photography Head · Open Source Contributor & Software Engineer

## About
YuYing — High school senior based in Taiwan, School Photography Head, indie software & AI engineer, NASA Challenge App Hackathon participant, AP CSA 5 scorer, and event/portrait photographer. Building local-first AI apps, browser-based 3D studio tools, and robotics projects.

## Featured Portfolio Projects
- **miu-pocket** (https://github.com/clark970417-eng/miu-pocket): Local-first PWA for notes, tools & self-hosted AI.
- **VocaLume** (https://github.com/clark970417-eng/VocaLume): Offline AI live captions & chat translator.
- **lumen-stage** (https://github.com/clark970417-eng/lumen-stage): 3D virtual studio to test lighting & cameras.
- **kano-record-shelf** (private): Touch-friendly 3D Kano album shelf & CD menu.
